items.summary: Update the single-page layout so the lip-biting emoji image section renders BELOW the long Rose Day final note/letter and ABOVE the footer signature text, with a visible vertical gap from the note, while keeping all other existing visuals and copy unchanged.

Change the lip-biting emoji caption text to be shown exactly as: “This is me when I see you:)” (matching capitalization and punctuation), and ensure it appears together with the lip-biting image in its new location.

Ensure Image 1 (the dog holding a rose in his mouth) is actually included and displayed directly ABOVE the first romantic line “I brought you a rose today…”, using a correct local static asset path under /assets/generated and preserving the global rule to omit the image entirely if it fails to load (no broken-image icon / placeholder).

Adjust the stage progression so the overall experience still progresses end-to-end exactly once per page load, without looping/blinking/restarting, and still reaches the final note + footer even if any image fails to load—while reflecting the new placement of the lip-biting section below the final note.
